title: North Yamanashi Cycling Trip
description: The OEC goes on a trip to northern Yamanashi to celebrate their new member: Mei Nakatsugawa. Aoi and Mei ride bicycles, while Aki and Toba-sensei drive cars to carry the equipment. At the same time, Rin is also doing her own solo trip to Gunma.

title: Gunma Golden Week Trip
description: Nadeshiko, Ena, and Ema go on a trip to Gunma during Golden Week. On this journey, they visit many places, including a retro train museum. The trip lasts for two nights and becomes the first camping trip for Ema Mizutani.

title: Route 152 Trip
description: Another trip during Golden Week. Ayano plans to ride through Yamanashi by taking a detour along the northern route. Meanwhile, Rin, who doesn’t have any plans during the holiday, wants to go on another bike tour. So she decides to head to Hamamatsu to ride together with Ayano again.

title: Manga Extra
description: A short addition about miscellaneous places that appear in the manga but are not part of any major trip.
